description: This file contains functions for managing secrets, including retrieving secrets from environment variables, secret managers, and handling various OIDC providers. It also includes utility functions for converting string values to booleans and determining whether to use a secret manager.

classes.name: DualCache
classes.description: A cache class used for storing OIDC tokens to avoid repeated HTTP requests.

classes.name: HTTPHandler
classes.description: A custom HTTP client used for making HTTP requests with specified timeouts.

methods.name: str_to_bool
methods.description: Converts a string to a boolean if recognized, otherwise returns None.

methods.name: get_secret_str
methods.description: Retrieves a secret and guarantees it is a string or None.

methods.name: get_secret_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a secret and guarantees it is a boolean or None.

methods.name: get_secret
methods.description: Main function to retrieve a secret from various sources including environment variables, secret managers, and OIDC providers.

methods.name: _should_read_secret_from_secret_manager
methods.description: Determines whether to read secrets from a secret manager based on configuration.
